items.title: TSUKIMICHI -Moonlit Fantasy-
items.essence_text: An isekai anime where an ordinary student is summoned to another world but cast aside by its goddess, forcing him to find his own path. The series emphasizes world-building and the protagonist's interactions with diverse non-human tribes, highlighting his extraordinary magical powers. It blends adventure with political intrigue and social commentary, as the protagonist strives to improve the world despite being rejected by humans and gods.
